name: Roan
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Roan, also spelled roane, is a cross-reference in the encyclopedia. The entry does not stand alone. It directs the reader to the entry for the Silkie. The two names point to the same folk creature.

okr.objective: Roan is a cross-reference pointing to the Silkie.
key_results: Roan is an alternate spelling of roane.
The entry directs the reader to Silkie.
It holds no information of its own.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
